keyFinding.title: What's a key?
keyFinding.body: A key is a family of notes that all lean toward one home note. Hold the right home underneath and the melody sits comfortably on top of it; hold the wrong one and some notes rub against it, and that rub is the itch you'll hear.

voiceLeading.title: What's voice leading?
voiceLeading.body: Voice leading is how a pianist moves between chords: each finger slides to the nearest note instead of jumping.
voiceLeading.off: Off: the chords around your choice hold still, so the only thing that changes is the chord you're testing. This is the clearest way to hear whether it fits.
voiceLeading.on: On: everything flows the way a pianist would play it. That can make a good choice sound even better, but it can also smooth over a weak one, so listen to the melody note: does it still sit comfortably on the chord?
